description: Authentication protocol enabling CI runners to exchange signed JWT tokens for short-lived cloud credentials.
Architecture eliminating static long-lived credentials from pipeline settings in favor of short-lived tokens.
Cryptographically verifiable workload identity URI uniquely identifying ephemeral software components.
OWASP risk category (CICD-SEC-6) covering vulnerabilities caused by hardcoded, long-lived or poorly protected secrets.
Field inside an OIDC JWT token specifying the exact repository, branch, and event triggering the build.
